measurement: event-store reads of one strategy cycle (WP-7.5)
findings: One configuration's three event-store reads take 496 ms p50 and 528 ms p95 with 200,000 events of its own in a 1.2M-event table; the 19,300-row qualification read is 401 ms p95 of that.

Of the qualification read, PostgreSQL takes about 120 ms (a parallel scan); the rest is decoding the rows into StrategyEvent models. An (workspace_id, strategy_id, event_type, observed_at) index did not change the total (p95 580 ms), so none is added.

With the CPU half (strategy-cycle-2026-10-03.json: 1.46 s p95 at 200 symbols at the close) a cycle is about 2 s, within the 30 s monitor interval; projection tables (roadmap step 4) are not needed for the acceptance.
